visualRegions.description: Complete bright airport terminal connecting passenger processing to aircraft, apron and runway
Terminal check-in hall with counters, kiosks, baggage scales and queue barriers at the left
Security screening lanes with x ray conveyor, trays, detector arch and inspection table
Departure concourse with gate seating, flight display, boarding podium and jet bridge at centre
Arrival hall with baggage claim carousel, suitcases, carts and customs lane at the right foreground
Airside view through terminal glazing with aircraft, jet bridge, apron, taxiway, runway and control tower
